title: Mochila Starvie Urban 2026 - Star Vie
description:
STARVIE URBAN 2026 BACKPACK - Ample space and maximum comfort for our material. With a single compartment for padel shoes. The STARVIE URBAN 2026 BACKPACK is designed to offer more practicality to the player who carries it, since it has a smaller size than a padel racket bag but is still great for carrying the most important things. Its measurements are 50 x 32 x 18.5 cm.

Its compact format and resistant materials allow you to transport all your equipment with total comfort. It has been made of Polyester + Polyester Basket which offers extra durability.

It incorporates different compartments for clothes, shoes, rackets, all of them separated to always have good organization.
